title: Open the New alert rule page

blocks.content:
A clear, descriptive name is the first thing responders see when an alert fires. A good name tells them immediately what's wrong without opening the alert details.

In this milestone, you'll open the **New alert rule** page and name your rule.

blocks.title: Open and name your alert rule

blocks.content: In the main menu, click **Alerting > Alert rules**.
Open **New alert rule**. If QuickPizza installation redirects you to the dashboards folder, open the form again.
If QuickPizza installation redirects you to the dashboards folder, reopen **New alert rule**.

blocks.reftarget: input[placeholder='Give your alert rule a name']

blocks.content: Your rule has a clear name. Next, you write the query in Code mode.
